A '''turbothrust''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that produced incredible speeds. [[Swoop/Legends|Swoops]] were fitted with turbothrusts to allow them to reach speeds up to six hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="SWS" />

Turbothrusts were also used as an enhancement for [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] to give them an extra boost of speed. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]] was fitted with a turbothrust.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
